newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS CUM-RIGHTS TRADING TO END.
newsitem.headline: UHIS CUM-RIGHTS TRADING TO END.

text.p: Uhispank shares will be traded with cum-rights for the last time today, the Tallinn stock exchange said on Wednesday.
Uhispank shares bought from Thursday will have no rights to participate in the bank's upcoming stock dividend issue, the bourse said in a statement distributed on the Internet.
The record date for the stock dividend issue is April 29.
Uhispank will issue stock dividends at a subscription ratio of 20:1 to raise its share capital to 246.75 million kroons from 235 million kroons.
The rights to participate in the share issue will be traded between April 29 and May 15, the bourse added.
